summary: Iteration 323 - DiaGyn Redesign Testing. All 11 frontend features PASSED. The page implements a 'hybrid' design with dark hero section + light booking flow. Hero shows 'Book Your Doctor Any Time Any Where!' with dual colors (Berry #E11D48 + Cyan #06B6D4). DoctorDetailModal, PatientInfoModal, and pre-booking confirmation all use light UI with berry accent. Time slots use horizontal date picker + Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night filter tabs.

findings: DiaGyn main page (/diagyn) renders with dark background (#0A0A0F base)
Hero shows 'Book Your Doctor Any Time Any Where!' with 'Any Time' in Berry (#E11D48) and 'Any Where!' in Cyan (#06B6D4)
BrandedLoader.jsx confirms DiaGyn loader uses Cyan (#06B6D4) for calendar + Rose (#E11D48) for lady figure and big tick mark
DoctorDetailModal opens in light UI (background: #F8F9FA) when clicking a doctor card
Doctor profile shows name (Dr. Vikas Jha), specialty (Diabetologist), stats (15 yrs Experience, 10,000+ Patients, 4.91 Reviews)
Clinic buttons (Pushpa, Amnion, Online) work correctly in light UI with colored borders on selection
Horizontal date picker shows next 7 days with 'TODAY' label on current day, berry highlight on selected date
Time period filter tabs (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Night) filter slots correctly with berry highlight on active tab
Time slots display in 3-column grid with berry/pink highlight on selection (6:15 PM, 6:30 PM, 6:45 PM, etc.)
'Book Now' button appears when slot is selected with berry color (#E11D48)
PatientInfoModal opens in light UI (white background) with berry accent on icon and Continue button
